paper_metadata.title: Emotional Resilience Predicts Preserved White Matter Microstructure following Mild Traumatic Brain Injury

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: The study uses a well-defined multicenter cohort (TRACK-TBI) with clear inclusion criteria. However, the specific analysis is restricted to a subset of patients who completed both 2-week and 6-month MRI scans (391 out of 1,132 eligible mTBI patients), which may introduce selection bias if those who returned for follow-up imaging differ from those who did not. Baseline characteristics show significant differences between ER and ND groups in sex and education, which are noted but not fully controlled for in the primary phenotype definition.

quips_assessment.risk_reasoning: While the study identifies significant differences in sex and education between the ER and ND groups, these were not used as covariates in the primary DTI analyses. The authors acknowledge this in the limitations, stating that sex differences cannot explain the longitudinal changes, but a formal multivariable adjustment for these confounders in the DTI models is not clearly presented.
